Phase-1 foundation training improves offline ranking metrics by **roughly 10–20%** compared with using an off-the-shelf LLM as the backbone (p. 7, Section 5.3). Table 1 states the same figure under the column "Offline ranking metrics (MRR)": "+ 10-20% compared to using an OSS model as base" (p. 7).

The authors credit this gain to the personalization and content-understanding capabilities that GenRec inherits from the Phase-1 foundational model (p. 7).

The paper gives the gain only as a 10–20% range. It does not give exact MRR values or say whether the percentage is relative or absolute.
